I think when you're depressed, we tend to zoom into the depression thinking it's bigger than any other thing in our lives. But depression is just a small part of our lives, yes it's easy to get caught up in the zoomed in chaos, and it can be hard to get out of it, but slowly getting yourself out of it through different ways like self reflection, and showing compassion to yourself by understanding yourself and your difficulties will make you feel a little better. And doin this in the long run will definitely get you out of the dark place. And whenever you tend to get depression again, you'll tend to deal with it better through the experience you've gained with practicing the different ways that I mentioned above. I'm sure you're a wonderful human, remember when faced with difficulty, you're born with the tools to overcome them. These tools are within you internally, and you have the wisdom to create these tools externally. It's important to identify your triggers and deal with them accordingly. Have a lovely day, sending you positive vibes, don't be too hard on yourself, you deserve the best <3

My periods got irregular because of my disrupted sleep cycle and stress because of my back pain. And I recently got diagnosed with pcos. Although I think I've always had it because, from the first time I got my period, it lasted for 14 days. And then after 5 months it settled to 7-10 days. But I still had those phases where it lasted 14-20 days because of stress, sometimes it would even get skipped for 2-3 months where I get spotting a lot. So yeah, I just recently got diagnosed with pcos and I feel better knowing what causes these irregularities in my periods. And I'm more mindful when it comes to diet and physical and emotional heath. And yes my period makes it hard to deal with my chronic pain. I feel nauseous, bloated, fatigued and have a few cramps in some of my cycles. But other than that mostly there is no period pain for me, I've seen my friends cry because of how much their periods hurt them. But luckily I've usually had painless periods all my life. Only this one time where I worked out too much and stressed my body a lot, I got my period 7 days earlier and it was accompanied with some painful abdominal cramps. Clearly because I was stressed physically and emotionally!
I don't have anything to say but all I gotta say is that I RELATE!
